_notes: Extra models for the HiFiMatch app. Entries here are added to the app's built-in list; a model already in the app is replaced by the entry here.
Prices are approximate SGD. sonic ratings are 1-10 for warm, neutral, dynamic, bass, vocals, refinement, finesse.
Amplifier fields: brand, model, price, launch, type (Integrated / Pre/Power / Preamp / Power), discontinued, watts8 (W per channel into 8 ohms), minImpedance, topology, sonic, url (optional).
Speaker fields: brand, model, price, launch, discontinued, sensitivity (dB), nominalImpedance, minRoom, maxRoom (sq m), speakerType, sonic, url (optional).
Entries missing brand, model, price, watts8 (amps) or sensitivity (speakers) are skipped. Keep commas between entries and none after the last one.

speakers._source: Hi-Fi+ (85 dB, 8 ohm), The Ear 2015 review (neutral, open, dynamic, clear vocals, smooth, limited bass below 50 Hz), hifiverse (45 Hz-22 kHz, ~20 sq m). Price: UK GBP 975 converted. Marked discontinued: appears superseded by an SE version (not confirmed).
